name: well
refs: Image 1: the accepted Pods screen concept. Look at the empty wells in the left column and the lit current well at the top.
prompt: Paint two EMPTY pod wells side by side, seen straight on, each a round glass well (circular recessed bezel with a thin circular ring groove around it, the inside a smooth dark glass bowl, empty, no pod) exactly in the design of the empty wells in the left column of Image 1. Left: the plain empty well. Right: the same well with its rim lit by a warm cream light (the current well in Image 1). Each well about 40 percent of the canvas width, centred vertically, on a perfectly flat uniform pure magenta background (hex FF00FF). No text, no numbers, no ring progress arcs, no stars.

name: hatch
refs: Image 1: the accepted Pods screen concept. Look at the small leaf mark at the bottom of the left column.
prompt: Paint one wide low glass hatch plate (a closed recessed hatch panel, 2:1, rounded corners, with a thin lit rim and a soft inner bevel) in the dark glass-and-graphite language of Image 1's left column, with a small fine engraved leaf mark in its centre like the one at the bottom of Image 1's left column (a single slim leaf outline, pale cyan hairline, about one quarter of the plate height). Seen straight on, on a perfectly flat uniform pure magenta background (hex FF00FF). No text, no numbers.
